explanations: Sun Goddess won the Juvenile Fillies Turf at Keeneland. Emphatic took the Juvenile Fillies on the same day.
The meeting is at Keeneland Race Course in Lexington, Kentucky. It is the 43rd edition of the Breeders' Cup, and all 14 races are Grade I.
He voted in the 2026 United States midterm elections. That makes him the first pontiff to vote in secular elections after taking office.
Will County is in Illinois, where Pope Leo XIV is a registered voter. He continued to vote in both state and federal elections as a bishop and as a cardinal.
The study analysed more than 7,000 fossils, along with records from over 400 living and extinct species. It was published in Science Advances by a team led by University College London.

sources.excerpt: The 2026 Breeders' Cup World Championships is the 43rd edition of the premier event of the North American Thoroughbred horse racing year. The 14 races, all of which are Grade I ranked, take place on October 30 and 31 at Keeneland Race Course in Lexington, Kentucky.

In thoroughbred horse racing, race horse Sun Goddess dominates the Juvenile Fillies Turf at the Keeneland racetrack in Lexington, Kentucky, United States during the Breeders' Cup. Additionally, Emphatic wins the Juvenile Fillies.
As pope, he voted in the 2026 United States midterm elections, making him the first pontiff to vote in secular elections after ascension to the papacy.
Throughout his time as a bishop and as a cardinal, Prevost continued to vote in both state and federal elections in the United States, being a registered voter in Will County, Illinois.

Scientists led by UCL (University College London) found that crocodiles and their ancient relatives spent much of their 250 million years of evolutionary history following warm climates rather than adapting to dramatically different temperatures.
Published in Science Advances, the study analyzed more than 7,000 fossils and records from over 400 living and extinct species.
The results suggest that tropical and subtropical regions remained suitable for crocodile relatives after the asteroid struck, even as the environments available to many dinosaurs deteriorated.
